provenance: recorded from a live OpenAI Responses API call (issue #989)

content.text: Start optimizing this listing. Look up the product information first. Call a tool; do not answer in prose.

request.instructions: You are Juli, optimizing a TikTok Shop listing. The product is already bound to this run - tools take no identifier arguments. Use the tools.

tools.description: Get an in-run snapshot of the bound product's current status. Not the authoritative confirmation of a status change — that arrives later via the product-status webhook.
tools.name: check_product_status

parameters.description:
No fields. The bound product identity comes from `ProductToolContext`,
never from model input (ADR-070 decision 1).
parameters.title: CheckProductStatusInput

tools.description: Get the current title and listing status for the bound product.
tools.name: get_product_information

parameters.description:
No fields. The bound product identity comes from `ProductToolContext`,
never from model input (ADR-070 decision 1).
parameters.title: GetProductInformationInput

tools.description: Get SEO keyword suggestions and title/description suggestions for the bound product, combined into one result.
tools.name: get_seo_keywords

parameters.description:
No fields. The bound product identity comes from `ProductToolContext`,
never from model input (ADR-070 decision 1).
parameters.title: GetSeoKeywordsInput

tools.description: Apply agent-authored title/description (and, if attach_staged_image is true, the run's staged image) to the bound product's listing.
tools.name: update_product_listing

parameters.description:
Agent-authored listing content for the bound product. No identifier
field, and no raw asset URI — the bound product identity comes from
`ProductToolContext.product_id`, and a staged image is referenced only by
the boolean `attach_staged_image` (ADR-070 decisions 1 and 2).
parameters.title: UpdateProductListingInput

tools.description: Apply new SKU prices (by opaque sku_ref) to the bound product. Independently rejectable from update_product_listing.
tools.name: update_product_price

ProductSkuPrice.description:
A single SKU's proposed price. `sku_ref` is a server-minted opaque
token (ADR-070 decision 1's reserved extension, e.g. `"S1"`) resolved
against `context.sku_refs` — never the raw vendor SKU id, and not a
second product identifier either way.
ProductSkuPrice.title: ProductSkuPrice

parameters.description:
No product identifier field, and no raw vendor SKU id — the bound
product identity comes from `ProductToolContext.product_id`, and each
SKU is targeted by opaque `sku_ref` only (ADR-070 decision 1).
Independently rejectable from `update_product_listing` — a separate
CONFIRM capability, not a bundled step.
parameters.title: UpdateProductPriceInput

tools.description: Screen and upload the seller-supplied candidate listing image staged for this run. The image is not applied to the listing until update_product_listing is called with attach_staged_image=True.
tools.name: upload_product_image

parameters.description:
No fields. The seller-supplied image bytes come from
`context.pending_image_bytes`, never from model output (ADR-070 decision
1) — a model cannot be asked to emit raw image bytes as output tokens.
parameters.title: UploadProductImageInput
